evals.prompt: There's a guy on Twitter who built a really good NHL goalie model. I want to bring him on as a contractor. How should we do it?
evals.expected_output: Names the gap, sets a capped trial, limits access, writes promises and gives a verdict at the end date.
expectations: Names the one skill gap and an inside estimate as a number
Sets a two-to-six-week paid trial with a dollar cap, end date and a check a command or file decides
Allows no production keys or member data during the trial and names a company owner
Ends with bring in, extend or part ways and hires, pays or grants access to no one

evals.prompt: Two people run a small odds-alert app with a few hundred users. I'd love to get them working for us.
evals.expected_output: Plans for the builders and their existing users.
expectations: Writes what happens to their users, with notice and an export before anything shuts
Writes the promises the owner makes to them
Sets a capped trial before any full deal
Leaves the decision and signing with the owner

evals.prompt: Where can we find money inside the company before we ask for a bigger budget?
